entry.title: Beyond Instruction Override: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injection with Task-Tampering Attacks
entry.summary:
Indirect prompt-injection (IPI) benchmarks predominantly test planted instructions that redirect a tool-using agent toward an attacker-chosen task. Yet attacker-controlled content can instead tamper with the outcome of the task already in progress. A buyer's dispute evidence can cite a false refund policy to inflate a refund without changing the task.

Source: arXiv Cryptography & Security (cs.CR) · Tags: #cryptography #zkp #ml-theory #agents

entry.title: Stop Calling Them Provers: The Case for Calling ProVerif and Tamarin Symbolic Protocol Analyzers
entry.summary:
A claim that a cryptographic protocol has been proved secure depends on the theory, the analysis software, the protocol model, and the security property being checked. I examine each of these for ProVerif and Tamarin. An audit of their published soundness arguments finds false statements, missing proofs, and gaps between the procedures justified on paper and those the tools run.

Source: IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive · Tags: #cryptography #zkp #rust #combinatorics

entry.title: Practical Optimal Bucket Sets with Power-of-Two Radices for LFG-Based MSM Algorithms
entry.summary:
Fixed point multi-scalar multiplication (MSM) is a major computational component of pairing-based SNARK proof generation. The Luo--Fu--Gong (LFG) framework is a variant of Pippenger's bucket method that uses a multiplier set $M$ and precomputed point multiples to reduce the number of buckets and online point additions. For radix $q$ and a positive multiplier set $M$, covering all digit residues requires a bucket set of size at least $q/(2|M|)$.

Source: IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive · Tags: #cryptography #zkp

entry.title: MuCPay: Breaking the Quadratic Bottleneck in Scriptless Multi-Party Oracle-Based Conditional Payments
entry.summary:
Oracle-based conditional payments triggered by real-world events support decentralized finance applications. However, dense independent bilateral deployments require $\Theta(Nn^2)$ outcome authorizations and $\Theta(n^2)$ settlement signatures for $n$ parties and $N$ outcomes. To go beyond two-party settings, we propose MuCPay, a multi-party oracle-based conditional payment protocol combining (i) $\Theta(Nn)$ off-chain signing shares with one on-chain settlement signature and (ii) BIP340-compatible scriptless settlement on Bitcoin.

Source: IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive · Tags: #cryptography #zkp

entry.title: Fully Homomorphic Encryption: A Mathematical Introduction
entry.summary:
We provide a mathematical introduction to fully homomorphic encryption (FHE), which enables computations to be performed on encrypted data without requiring decryption. We begin with a brief overview of the historical development of FHE, then focus on Fully Homomorphic Encryption over the Torus (TFHE), describing its underlying mathematical structure and fundamental homomorphic operations. Particular attention is given to key switching and bootstrapping, including their roles in managing ciphertext noise and supporting computations of greater depth.

Source: IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive · Tags: #cryptography #zkp
